_comment: 30-case adversarial spoiler hunt. Generated 2026-05-29. Reuses the fairy-tale fixture.json. 4 spoiler axes: plot_outcome (10), character_arc (8), mechanism_reveal (7), identity_break (5). Format matches cases.json so run.ts --cases <this-file> just works. Every case opts into qa_max_sentences=2 + qa_no_meta_preface (free deterministic gates from PR #4) and uses forbidden_in_planner (which grader checks against BOTH qa_answer and planner text) — so a 'yes, she dies' leak is caught deterministically without the judge. The scorecard prefix-maps every label 'spoiler-hunt-*' into the spoiler-defence category. Purpose: stress-test the C7-armA redact-ending fix across all 4 axes so axis-specific overfit becomes visible.
